channel.title: Syria, The Rest
channel.desc: The war in Syria is entering its seventh year. More than half of the population has been driven from their homes and many people have been repeatedly displaced. Christians, as a minority community, have suffered from a double vulnerability: the general breakdown of society and above all the targeted attacks of Islamic fundamentalists. Of the 1.2 million Christians who lived in Syria, more than 700,000 fled. Le Restant allows Christians to testify and tell their story of this tragedy of modern times. (30 minutes).
